text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In the Representative Exchange Race, Tap 
Dance City gave it her all with her 
signature running style. Her race stirred 
up great anticipation among the 
spectators.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, Tap Dance City chose to decline 
the spot as representative. She felt in 
this race that, as she was now, her dream 
remained out of reach.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The announcement of Japan's 
representative—<chrname> is successfully chosen, 
and Tap Dance City decides to shift to a 
support role by her own request.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This year, she entrusts her dream to <chrname>. 
Carrying Tap Dance City's hopes, they aim 
to conquer the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe 
as a team.
